text:
ana_cs: Quick sync 8:30 PT tomorrow for HorizonLabs reserved bring-up. Short goal: smoke run + degrade-recovery test. 30m slot.

rob_sre: I can join. What quota numbers are we validating?

ana_cs: Committed 4k steady, burst 6k, per-account bucket mapped to reserved pool.

jia_platform: Will confirm the bucket mapping and node templates. Note: staging showed one instance type with slow attestation (110s).

nate_se: Customer expects p95 < 300ms for small prompts. We may need cache priming and a smaller-model fallback.

vera_ops: Proposed checklist:
- KV priming 08:00
- patch quota 08:15
- smoke 08:30 (5 min @ 400 RPS)
- main ramp 08:40 (ramp to 4k, hold 8m)
- inject degraded nodes at T+5m
- post-run logs + screenshots 09:45

rob_sre: autoscaler config: min=1, target=6, max=10, step=+1, cooldown=90s. If node boot >100s switch min=2.

nate_se: We'll prepare fallback route to quantized-medium and a demo of routing 25% traffic on trigger.

jia_platform: I'll add an autoscale probe and a synthetic health check to ensure nodes register before routing traffic.

deploy-bot: deployment queued: reserved/horizonlabs/smokewalk-2025-03-18T08:30Z -> cluster-staging-5

ana_cs: Can we also run a soft-throttle test to ensure per-account limiting kicks in? small bursts of 8k for 20s.

rob_sre: yes will script a short spike at T+3m. If throttle fires, confirm 429 handling & client retry headers.

vera_ops: Add monitoring endpoints to dashboard: token-usage, per-route latency (p50/p95/p99), gpu temp, disk i/o. Set alert: p95>800ms for 120s -> paged to rob_sre.

nate_se: I'll prepare a 3-question feedback form for HorizonLabs: (1) latency satisfaction, (2) dashboard clarity, (3) acceptable fallback behavior.

ana_cs: Renewal note: if we see >10% delta versus expected p95 we flag renewal risk and offer a targeted enablement session + one-week billing credit option. Capture that decision in the post-run artifact.

jia_platform: Chaos plan: at T+5m kill two serving pods, watch autoscaler, then respawn. I'll time the kill during steady-state hold.

rob_sre: k6 profile ready: ramp 50 -> 4k in 6m, hold 8m, spike 8k for 20s at T+3m, degrade at T+5m. Posting snippet in repo.

deploy-bot: run started (priming) 2025-03-18T08:00:12Z

ana_cs: Please record a 2min screencap of the dashboard peaks for customer deliverable.

rob_sre: post-run: priming reduced cold-starts by 60%. p95 averaged 290ms at committed 4k; spike produced graceful throttles, autoscaler added nodes 3->9 within 160s after chaos. No persistent errors.

nate_se: customer feedback: liked the throttle transparency but asked for clearer retry guidance in SDK. Logged as product ticket.

ana_cs: Outcome: smokewalk passed. Recommend green for cutover with follow-up enablement and SDK retry doc update. I'll file the playbook and attach run artifacts.

vera_ops: moving notes to playbooks/horizon-smokewalk-2025-03.json and closing thread.

deploy-bot: ticket CS-8812 updated: horizon labs smokewalk complete
